notes: Man in dark jacket and a companion stand at the propped door all minute.
Man in blue walks to the right edge and vanishes; women in black pass in the foreground on the left side, direction unclear, not counted.
Two women in dark coats with backpacks cross the foreground right to left near the end; possibly a third.
Woman with shopping bag lingers near the door then walks up to the camera; no crossing seen.
Close-up head blocks part of view early; the dark-jacket man who stood at the door is gone by mid-strip and may have left unseen; new browsers came from the left.
Man in cap and a blue-haired woman in polka-dot jacket come in from the right early, then stand close to the camera.
Two men appear behind the foreground woman near the end, apparently entering; direction not certain.
Blue-haired woman stands in the foreground; legs seen moving near the door behind her but no clear crossing.
Foreground pair talking; person in beige by the door gestures to someone behind the glass.
Foreground woman and a near head hide much of the door area; figures shift behind the glass but no crossing could be followed.
Several dark-clothed figures appear near the door and drift left behind the foreground woman in the last row; count is an estimate.
Foreground pair hides much of the door side; a man in a puffer vest and a person in a cap appear near the door and move in, other figures mill behind, count uncertain.
Figures stand behind the glass leaf; foreground pair moves off and two men in caps walk from the room toward the door but are still in view at the end.
Man in black jacket seems to exit at right edge early; logo-jacket man at door vanishes as a curly-haired woman with a tablet appears in his place; he may only be behind the glass.
Woman with tablet stands at the door all minute; people visible standing behind the glass; passers in foreground do not cross.
Logo-jacket man reappears from the door edge; a couple with tote bags shows up close to the camera and walks into the room, entry from the right assumed, not seen directly.
Someone joins the greeter-like woman at the door mid-strip; a young man then stands right at the camera for the last row, hiding most of the scene.
First five tiles blocked by a man at the camera; a crowd is milling when view clears, origin unknown; one person in grey fleece seems to enter in the last row.
One person in grey jacket enters past the woman at the door; later a group of about three women (one in zebra coat) comes in across the foreground from the right.
Logo-jacket man stands at the camera much of the minute; a woman in a brown puffer walks toward the right foreground and vanishes, taken as leaving.
Person in scarf and glasses comes from the door area toward the camera; logo-jacket man reappears from the right foreground edge though his exit was not seen.
Logo-jacket man walks up to the camera and back; a figure lingers behind the glass for a few tiles without clearly crossing.
Young man in black and a bearded man with a backpack enter in the first row; the backpack then blocks most of the view for the rest.
Three people chat at the door all minute; a man in a bright blue jacket appears from the right foreground in the last tile.
Blue-jacket man slips behind the glass leaf for a few tiles then comes back in and stands near the camera, partly blocking the lower view.
Woman in black walks to the door, stands, disappears, and a similar woman in black comes back from the door edge soon after.
Masked woman in black and a woman in grey sweater and white trousers come from the door past the chatting trio; blue-jacket man in the first tile vanishes, direction unknown.
Trio keeps chatting by the door; heads at the lower left do not block the right edge.
Trio by the door; foreground heads on the left side only.
Woman in beige jacket walks from the door group up to the camera and back; no one crosses the edge.
Person in beanie and blue fleece with backpack walks to the right foreground edge and vanishes near the end; others mill in the foreground.
Chatting trio and bystanders only; nobody crosses the right edge.
In the last row a blue-haired woman and a man in a cap head to the door and vanish; a dark figure at right foreground in the first tile also disappears, direction unknown, not counted.
Man in black with a cap steps in from the door edge near the end and stands there; a figure waits behind the glass.
Man in black at the door steps out; curly-haired woman strides to the door, is out of view for two tiles, then returns to the group.
Blue-jacket man comes up from the right foreground and goes into the room; a dark figure in a cap appears by the door in the last row while a close-up head blocks the left.
